claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu alleges a surge in low-astral activity after the April 8, 2024 eclipse, which she says ship sensors and screened online reports indicated, including frequency hotspots where astral and material ranges overlap.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She acknowledges most online content is false and says videos alone prove nothing; the report is framed as entertainment.

review_flags: The source presents unverifiable paranormal claims and conspiratorial explanations of current events.
coverage_gaps: The video also attributes portal openings and paranormal danger to alleged rituals and gives advice about purported spirits.
